# Takevolet (RoomRelay)
> India's premier zero-brokerage rental discovery, reels shorts, and cadastral land survey platform.

## Overview
Takevolet connects property owners, flatmates, and prospective tenants directly across major Indian metropolitan hubs including Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Mumbai, Chennai, and Delhi NCR with 0% brokerage fees.

## Core Capabilities & Offerings
- **Direct Owner Rentals**: Verified 1 BHK, 2 BHK, 3 BHK, and shared flats for rent with zero commission.
- **Flatmate Matchmaking**: Find verified male/female roommates based on profession, lifestyle, dietary preferences, and commute.
- **Paying Guest (PG) & Co-Living Spaces**: Curated PGs with amenities (Wi-Fi, food, housekeeping, security, power backup).
- **Video Property Shorts & Reels**: Full-screen 9:16 vertical video walkthroughs of verified rooms and apartments with attached direct-booking cards.
- **"Know Your Survey Number" Cadastral GIS Portal**: State-wise Indian land records & GIS cadastral map verification covering:
  - Telangana: Dharani Portal & Bhu-Naksha Cadastral Maps
  - Andhra Pradesh: Meebhoomi Adangal & Cadastral Survey Numbers
  - Karnataka: Bhoomi & Dishaank Cadastral Survey App
  - Maharashtra: MahaBhulekh 7/12 Extract
  - Tamil Nadu: Patta Chitta Survey Number Portal
  - Uttar Pradesh: UP Bhulekh Cadastral Maps
  - Pan-India: ISRO Bhuvan Geo-Spatial Platform
- **Top Projects Hub**: Verified new launch gated communities, RERA-approved builder apartments, and downloadable floor plan brochures.

## Target Localities
- **Hyderabad**: HITEC City, Gachibowli, Madhapur, Kondapur, Financial District, Tellapur, Manikonda, Miyapur, Kukatpally.
- **Bengaluru**: Koramangala, Indiranagar, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Electronic City, Bellandur, Marathahalli, BTM Layout.
- **Pune**: Hinjewadi, Wakad, Baner, Kharadi, Viman Nagar, Magarpatta.
